notes: Phase 1 of pre-merge review fixes: conditional preventDefault() in _onWheel. Bug was unconditional e.preventDefault() at line 329 which blocked page scrolling when a panel was selected but wheel event had zero deltas. Fix: added hasAction flag that tracks whether pan (deltaX/deltaY) or zoom (deltaZ/ctrlKey+deltaY) was processed; only call preventDefault() when hasAction is true. Added 5 new tests: zero deltas, pan delta, zoom delta, both pan+zoom, and ctrlKey with zero deltas (per world-review). All 45 MultiTouchHandler tests pass. No refactoring needed — change was minimal and clean. World-review also raised deltaMode concern (DOM_DELTA_PAGE) but deemed low-risk and out of scope.
